_published_faq.name: How do I add Benevity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Benevity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.benevity.org/general/v1/nonprofit.

_published_faq.name: Is Benevity MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Benevity scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Benevity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Benevity provides these MCP tools: Benevity Nonprofit Search and Benevity Get Nonprofit Details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Benevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Benevity in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Candid, Chariot, and Givebutter.
Benevity does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
